facts.summary: Phase 2 final data showed ANC increase and G-CSF reduction, stock fell anyway · Phase 2 completed · mavorixafor in chronic neutropenia · not yet approved

evidence.summary: An analysis of final data from the six-month study showed that once-daily oral mavorixafor durably and meaningfully increased participants’ mean absolute neutrophil counts (“ANC”).
evidence.safety: Overall, mavorixafor was generally well tolerated as a monotherapy and in combination with G-CSF, with no drug-related serious adverse events reported, consistent with previous clinical studies.
